card.name: Sentence breaks after treatment-risk statements
card.fires_on: A period or the word "but" that ends a clause about adverse events in treated patients, such as suicides on drug versus placebo or GI events on NSAID therapy. The next words would start a new point.

card.plain: It marks the point after a sentence about side effects in treated patients, where the word treatment is unlikely to come next.
